displayAddress: Flat 72 The Exchange, Percy Street, Preston
description:
This modern apartment is an excellent buy-to-let investment opportunity. Situated in the heart of Preston city centre, where rental demand remains consistently high, the property is ideally positioned to attract tenants. 

Residents enjoy a fantastic selection of amenities, including shops, bars, cafes, and restaurants right on the doorstep. Excellent transport links are also within easy walking distance, with both the bus station and train station nearby, making it an ideal location for commuters and city professionals alike.

Upon entering the apartment, you are welcomed into a bright and inviting open-plan lounge and kitchen, creating the perfect space for relaxing, dining, and entertaining. The well-designed layout maximises both space and natural light, providing a comfortable and contemporary living environment. The property also benefits from a generously sized double bedroom and a modern bathroom, completing this well-presented apartment.

The Exchange offers residents thoughtfully designed communal spaces, including a stylish residents' lounge and a landscaped roof garden, creating a welcoming environment to relax and socialise.

Residents also benefit from a range of premium amenities, including a fully equipped gym, secure bicycle storage, and a hotel-style concierge service, providing both convenience and peace of mind.

The property is currently tenanted and generates a rental income of £925 per calendar month.

Please contact Open House Lancashire to arrange your viewing.

Council Tax Band: A
Tenure: Leasehold (247 years)
Ground Rent: £140 per year
Service Charge: £1,900 per year
